name: Spotless Studios — Airbnb 365-Day STR Occupancy & Rate Comp Monitor

parameters.content:
## Airbnb Forward Calendar & Occupancy Monitor

1. Set `APIFY_API_TOKEN` in n8n environment variables.
2. Edit `locations` (e.g. `["Austin, TX", "Scottsdale, AZ"]`) in the HTTP Request node.
3. Replace the final Webhook URL with your BI/Airtable/Notion/Slack endpoint to ingest 30/90/365-day STR occupancy metrics.
